title:
An epic to update a component's filter and trigger a data request.
Payloads to include are:
  - dataSourceId: The data source ID for the relevant component.
  - filterField: The field on the entity type on which to filter.
  - useIntersectionFilter: A boolean indicating whether the intersection filter should be used. When false or not defined, the equality filter is used.
  - filterValueFieldPath: The string path to get to the value(s) to use for the filter. Retrieves the value from the action payload by default.
  - additionalFilter: A filter string to be appended to the constructed filter with an "and".
  - useApplicationState: A boolean indicating whether the filter values are obtained from application state instead of from the action payload.
name: UiSdlEpicUpdateComponentFilter
